subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, com autonomia, textos instrucionais de regras de jogo, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, de acordo com as convenções do gênero e considerando a situação comunicativa e a finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar as convenções do gênero de textos instrucionais como regras de jogos
components.description_en: Identify genre conventions of instructional texts such as game rules
components.cc_component_description: Identify how genre conventions shape an author's treatment of a shared subject

components.description_pt: Planejar a escrita considerando propósito, audience e as ideias mais significativas a comunicar
components.description_en: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Produzir um texto instrucional de forma independente seguindo convenções do gênero
components.description_en: Produce an instructional text independently following genre conventions

cc_matches.description: Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
Compare and contrast texts in different forms or genres (e.g., stories and poems; historical novels and fantasy stories) in terms of their approaches to similar themes and topics.
